visible_turns.text: What did you do last night ?
Did you watch the Barcelona versus Madrid game ?
What were the results of the game ?
Really ? I thought Barcelona was going to win . They are a much better team than Madrid .

atoms.claim: B likely watched or knew the results of the Barcelona versus Madrid game, since A directed questions about the game's outcome specifically to B
B provided information about the results of the Barcelona versus Madrid game that surprised A, indicating the game did not end with a Barcelona win
B provided information about the Barcelona versus Madrid game that contradicted A's expectation that Barcelona would win.
